sources.title: Zhu/Dann/Marson primary CD4 T-cell genome-scale Perturb-seq

sources.title: Nadig 2025 HepG2 Perturb-seq (scPerturb mirror, acquired)
sources.role: third perturbed biological context: leave-one-context-out training and test
limits: 0/300 direct panel coverage, verified again after acquisition: this source measures transfer between contexts, never coverage of the VCC panel.
A mirror is a copy of an experiment, not a second experiment. It must never be summed with the GEO original nor treated as replication.
The matrix is the only one in the file: no layers, no raw, no obsm. There is nothing to fall back to if X were not counts.
Guides are pooled per target: this source has no guide-level pseudobulk rows, so guide-level splits are not available from it.
sources.count_schema: integer counts, single cell; stored dense float32, gzip-chunked (569 x 76); 145,473 x 9,624. Sampled 3,072 cells: non-negative, integral, no zero-library cell, median library 15,778, consistent with obs.ncounts (median 15,487). Dense would be 5.6 GB and is never materialised.
sources.ntc_rule: obs.perturbation == 'control' (4,976 cells) in this harmonised mirror. The 2026-09-12 probe of the GEO original recorded obs.gene == 'non-targeting' for the same cells: the mirror renames, it does not re-measure.
sources.guide_ids: obs.guide_id, 2,679 levels; guides are pooled per target in the signatures

gene_axis.note: Official-axis genes absent from this source are unmeasured, not unchanged.

k562_gwps.note: Panel overlap is not the same as a usable effect estimate. RPE1 essential is a transfer benchmark, not panel supervision.

k562_essential.note: Panel overlap is not the same as a usable effect estimate. RPE1 essential is a transfer benchmark, not panel supervision.

rpe1_essential.note: Panel overlap is not the same as a usable effect estimate. RPE1 essential is a transfer benchmark, not panel supervision.

executable_experiments.limitation: Only 2 perturbed context(s) are local. A test that holds one out leaves a single training context and is not a general demonstration of learning context dependence.

executable_experiments.requires: shared targets between a train context and a held-out context
executable_experiments.limitation: with two contexts this is 1-vs-1 transfer

executable_experiments.requires: the same shared-target pool, with a seed-controlled subset excluded from all training responses

executable_experiments.reason: no local real perturbed single-cell counts with paired NTCs
executable_experiments.do_not: Do not replace the real reference with synthetic cells. Do not interpret a generator improvement as evidence about the predictor or about modularity.

unmeasured_vs_unchanged: A gene absent from a source's var is unmeasured. Treating it as log2FC = 0 invents evidence in the direction of no effect (D-009).
perturbed_contexts_local_rule: on disk, perturbed cells, any matrix kind; the unperturbed official controls are excluded by cell_state
